prompt:
Support ticket: "My project cover came back as failed, and 15 credits were gone anyway. Same thing happened earlier with a character sheet."
Users must not pay for AI work that failed. Fix it everywhere credits are charged, not only for covers. Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Users want to see where their credits went. Add `GET /api/v1/workspaces/{id}/credits/history`: the workspace's credit changes, newest first, with every charge, refund and daily refill. Each item has `amount` (negative for a charge), `action` and `created_at`. A refunded charge and its refund both appear.
Only members of the workspace may read it; to anyone else the workspace does not exist (404). Add tests.
On the Settings page, under the credit balance, show this history: when, what it was for, and the amount, with refunds marked as refunds. Both languages.

report.answer: The Settings page now shows a credit history table under the balance, with when, what it was for and the amount. Refunds read "Refund: <action>", and charges and refunds are coloured differently. The English and Korean message files have the same new keys. `tsc` and eslint are clean on the new component. I didn't open the page in a browser.

+def credit_history(
+    workspace_id: UUID,
+    session: Session = Depends(deps.get_session),

+    def refund_credits(self, session: Session, workspace_id: UUID, user_id: UUID | None, action_type: str) -> None:
+        """
+        Gives back the credits charged for an action whose AI work failed,
+        and records a positive "refund:<action>" transaction.
+        """
+        workspace = session.get(Workspace, workspace_id)
+        if not workspace:
+            return
+        tier = workspace.tier if workspace.tier else "free"
+        cost = self.PRICING.get(action_type, {}).get(tier, 5)
+
+        workspace.credits += cost
+        session.add(workspace)
+        session.add(CreditTransaction(
+            workspace_id=workspace_id,
+            user_id=user_id or workspace.owner_id,
+            amount=cost,
+            action_type=f"refund:{action_type}",
+            timestamp=datetime.utcnow()
+        ))
+        session.commit()
+
+    def refund_in_new_session(self, workspace_id: UUID | None, user_id: UUID | None, action_type: str) -> None:
+        """Refund helper for background tasks; never raises."""
+        if workspace_id is None:
+            return
+        try:
+            from app.db.engine import engine
+            with Session(engine) as session:
+                self.refund_credits(session, workspace_id, user_id, action_type)
+        except Exception as e:
+            print(f"Credit refund failed for {action_type}: {e}")
+
+    @contextmanager
+    def refund_on_failure(self, session: Session, workspace_id: UUID, user_id: UUID, action_type: str):
+        """
+        Wrap the AI work of an already-charged action: if it raises, the
+        credits are refunded and the exception propagates.
+        """
+        try:
+            yield
+        except BaseException:
+            session.rollback()
+            self.refund_credits(session, workspace_id, user_id, action_type)
+            raise

+from tests.conftest import signup

+
+def test_history_lists_charge_and_refund_newest_first(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "T", "genres": []}).json()["id"]
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h)

+"""Credits are given back when the AI work they paid for fails."""
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import FakeGemini
+
+
+def _credits(client, h):
+    return client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["credits"]
+
+
+def _setup(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []}).json()
+    char = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/characters", headers=h,
+        json={"project_id": project["id"], "name": "Mina"},
+    )
+    assert char.status_code == 200, char.text
+    return h, project["id"], char.json()["id"]
+
+
+def test_failed_cover_is_refunded(client):
+    h, pid, _ = _setup(client)
+    before = _credits(client, h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h).status_code == 200
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}", headers=h).json()["cover_image_status"] == "failed"
+    assert _credits(client, h) == before
+
+
+def test_successful_cover_is_charged(client):
+    h, pid, _ = _setup(client)
+    before = _credits(client, h)
+    client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h)
+    assert _credits(client, h) == before - 15
+
+
+def test_failed_character_sheet_is_refunded(client):
+    h, _, cid = _setup(client)
+    before = _credits(client, h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/characters/{cid}/generate", headers=h).status_code == 200
+    assert _credits(client, h) == before
+
+
+def test_failed_sync_ai_calls_are_refunded(client):
+    h, pid, _ = _setup(client)
+    before = _credits(client, h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/characters/suggestions/batch", headers=h, json={"project_id": pid})
+    assert r.status_code == 500
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/scenes/render", headers=h, json={"prompt": "a bus", "project_id": pid})
+    assert r.status_code == 500
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/scenes/structure", headers=h, json={"script": "x", "project_id": pid})
+    assert r.status_code == 500
+    assert _credits(client, h) == before
+
+
+def test_failed_style_preview_is_refunded(client):
+    h, _, _ = _setup(client)
+    before = _credits(client, h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/styles", headers=h, json={"name": "Ink", "description": "ink wash"})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert _credits(client, h) == before

@@ -0,0 +1,81 @@
+'use client';
+
+import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
+import { useLocale, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
+import api from '@/lib/api';
+
+interface CreditHistoryItem {
+    amount: number;
+    action: string;
+    created_at: string;
+}
+
+const REFUND_PREFIX = 'refund:';
+
+// The backend sends naive UTC timestamps; make them explicit before parsing.
+function parseTimestamp(value: string): Date {
+    return new Date(/[zZ]|[+-]\d\d:?\d\d$/.test(value) ? value : `${value}Z`);
+}
+
+export default function CreditHistory({ workspaceId, credits }: { workspaceId: string; credits: number }) {
+    const t = useTranslations('Settings.creditHistory');
+    const locale = useLocale();
+    const [items, setItems] = useState<CreditHistoryItem[] | null>(null);
+    const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);
+
+    // Reload when the balance changes so new charges and refunds show up.
+    useEffect(() => {
+        let cancelled = false;
+        api.get<CreditHistoryItem[]>(`/workspaces/${workspaceId}/credits/history`)
+            .then((res) => { if (!cancelled) { setItems(res.data); setFailed(false); } })
+            .catch(() => { if (!cancelled) setFailed(true); });
+        return () => { cancelled = true; };
+    }, [workspaceId, credits]);
+
+    const actionLabel = (action: string) => {
+        const key = `actions.${action}`;
+        return t.has(key) ? t(key) : action;
+    };
+
+    return (
+        <div className="mt-6">
+            <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-white mb-3">{t('title')}</h3>
+            {failed ? (
+                <p className="text-sm text-red-400">{t('error')}</p>
+            ) : items === null ? (
+                <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">{t('loading')}</p>
+            ) : items.length === 0 ? (
+                <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">{t('empty')}</p>
+            ) : (
+                <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-gray-800">
+                    <table className="w-full text-sm">
+                        <thead className="text-left text-gray-400 bg-[#0A0A0B]">
+                            <tr>
+                                <th className="px-4 py-2 font-medium">{t('when')}</th>
+                                <th className="px-4 py-2 font-medium">{t('what')}</th>
+                                <th className="px-4 py-2 font-medium text-right">{t('amount')}</th>
+                            </tr>
+                        </thead>
+                        <tbody>
+                            {items.map((item, i) => {
+                                const isRefund = item.action.startsWith(REFUND_PREFIX);
+                                const label = isRefund
+                                    ? t('refund', { action: actionLabel(item.action.slice(REFUND_PREFIX.length)) })
+                                    : actionLabel(item.action);
+                                return (
+                                    <tr key={i} className="border-t border-gray-800 text-gray-300">
+                                        <td className="px-4 py-2 whitespace-nowrap">{parseTimestamp(item.created_at).toLocaleString(locale)}</td>
+                                        <td className="px-4 py-2">{label}</td>
+                                        <td className={`px-4 py-2 text-right font-mono ${item.amount < 0 ? 'text-red-400' : 'text-green-400'}`}>
+                                            {item.amount > 0 ? `+${item.amount}` : item.amount}
+                                        </td>
+                                    </tr>
+                                );
+                            })}
+                        </tbody>
+                    </table>
+                </div>
+            )}
+        </div>
+    );
+}
